PROVENANCE OF THE ENGINE FIXTURES (checked 2026-10-20)

Every fixture file is a synthetic re-creation written by make_fixtures.py. No
third-party export, and no row from any real account, is committed. The files
copy only the HEADER STRUCTURE (column names, order, date and number style,
section titles) described by the public sources below. Account, owner-name,
alias, comment and report-header fields hold the canary CANARY-ZQ7X.

Result of the step-1 sample hunt (RISKIEST ASSUMPTION): no downloadable real
export was found for any format in the time box. What was found is
documentation and open-source importer code that names the columns. So every
broker parser ships verified_format = false ("beta — format not yet
confirmed") and emits W_UNVERIFIED_FORMAT. The generic template is ours and is
verified. Cheapest fix: the owner exports one MT5 demo History report as HTML.

Format: MetaTrader 5 report (HTML; Deals, Positions, Orders sections)
  1. MetaTrader 5 Help, "Trading Report" (metatrader5.com/en/terminal/help/
     trading_advanced/history_report). Read 2026-10-19 (saved copy). Gives the
     blocks: Header (broker, account number, owner name, currency, date),
     Orders, Deals, Positions, Working Orders, Summary, Details. NOTE: it says
     the Positions block shows OPEN positions only. Whether a closed-positions
     table exists in current builds is UNVERIFIED; the engine supports both.
  2. MQL5 article 5436 (mql5.com/en/articles/5436): Deals column order
     Time, Deal, Symbol, Type, Direction, Volume, Price, Order, Commission,
     Fee, Swap, Profit, Balance, Comment. Licence: MQL5 site terms; facts only
     used, nothing copied.
  3. TradeNote (github.com/Eleven-Trading/TradeNote, src/utils/brokers.js,
     GPL-3.0, read via cdn.jsdelivr.net 2026-10-20): its MT5 importer finds a
     "Trade History Report" title and a "Deals" section, uses the same column
     order (Commission at index 8, Fee 9, Swap 10, Profit 11), lowercase
     "buy"/"sell" and "in"/"out", "yyyy.mm.dd HH:MM:SS" times, and skips rows
     whose type is "balance". Facts only; no code copied.
  Encoding UTF-16LE with BOM: UNVERIFIED (common report); fixture
  mt5/deals_netting_utf16.htm tests it.

Format: MetaTrader 4 statement (HTML, one row per round trip)
  MetaTrader 4 Help, "Account History" (metatrader4.com/en/trading-platform/
  help/overview/terminal/terminal_account_history): columns Order, Time, Type,
  Size, Symbol, Price, S/L, T/P, Time, Price, Commission, Taxes, Swap, Profit.
  Section titles "Closed Transactions:", "Open Trades:", "Working Orders:",
  "Summary:" and the "Ticket"/"Item" spellings are UNVERIFIED (from memory of
  the detailed statement); both spellings are accepted.

Format: IBKR Flex Query, Trades (CSV)
  1. IBKR Reporting Reference, Trades Flex fields (ibkrguides.com/
     reportingreference/reportguide/tradesfq.htm) and codes (codes_flex.htm):
     field display names; O = opening, C = closing, P = partial.
  2. Tapeboard import manual (tapeboard.com/manual/import-ibkr-flex-csv):
     expects Symbol, AssetClass, CurrencyPrimary, TradeDate, DateTime,
     Quantity, Price, IBCommission, Buy/Sell.
  3. TradeNote (as above, GPL-3.0): Trade Confirmation Flex with
     ClientAccountID, AssetClass, Date/Time ("yyyyMMdd;HHmmss"),
     CurrencyPrimary, Buy/Sell ("BUY"/"SELL"), Code (contains O or C),
     Symbol, Quantity (signed), Price, Commission, Proceeds. Its README gives
     the Flex settings: CSV, column headers yes, header/trailer records no,
     date yyyyMMdd, time HHmmss, separator ";".
  Fixtures: ibkr/activity_flex.csv (sources 1–2 spellings),
  ibkr/trade_confirm_fx.csv (source 3 spellings + FXRateToBase,
  FifoPnlRealized, LevelOfDetail). Realized P&L being net of commission is
  UNVERIFIED.
  ibkr/cnh_offshore_yuan.csv (synthetic, sources 1–2 spellings): CurrencyPrimary
  CNH, the offshore-yuan code IBKR writes for CNH-settled trades; CNH is not an
  ISO 4217 code but is on the engine's currency list.

Format: Tradovate Orders report (CSV)
  1. TradeZella integration page (tradezella.com/integrations/tradovate):
     column list orderId, Account, Order ID, B/S, Contract, Product, Product
     Description, avgPrice, filledQty, Fill Time, lastCommandId, Status, ...,
     Filled Qty, Avg Fill Price.
  2. TradeNote (as above, GPL-3.0): keeps Status "Filled" after trimming,
     trims " Buy"/" Sell", reads Fill Time and a Date that may have a 2-digit
     year. Month-first dates are UNVERIFIED. No commissions in this report.

Format: generic template and round-trip layout
  Ours (TRADER-REPORT-INPUT-FORMATS §2D), aligned with Tradervue's generic
  format (tradervue.com/help/generic) and TradeZella's generic CSV help
  article (round-trip columns Open Time, Close Time, Symbol, Direction,
  Volume, Open Price, Close Price; UNVERIFIED as exact spellings).
